title: Nine Hundredweight of Weighing
subtitle: 煤炭与能源 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 煤炭与能源（自然生态·能源与矿产）
meta: 主题语境：煤炭与能源（自然生态·能源与矿产）　|　核心词汇：coal　|　正文 332 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 coal 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1946 my mother was sent to weigh ① coal she could not lift, and she said the weighing was the whole of the lesson. The ② coal, meaning the fuel and not the mine, was nine hundredweight and was weighed by whoever came last; coal, she said, is the only thing in a cellar that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ coal in that cellar had the same dust, and the ④ coal at the end, meaning the one the merchant kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever weighed properly. Coal, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ coal was the whole of the winter, meaning the heat it carried and not the fuel. The ⑥ coal, meaning the heat and not any of that, is the only thing in a winter that everybody shares and nobody questions; coal, he said, is either something you weigh or the only word that means both a fuel and heat. She said the heat is the part they remember.

By 1961 the ⑦ coal had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the dust. The ⑧ coal of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine hundredweight and eleven years of weighing; coal, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ coal I remember is the one at the end, which was weighed in 1966 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ coal, my grandmother said in 1971, is the only thing that improves by being weighed; every coal, she said, is heat that has agreed to look like a fuel. She said the heat was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 煤（指那些燃料本身，与那座矿井相对）
C. 固定搭配：weigh coal 称煤
D. n. 煤（指地窖里每一堆）
E. n. 煤（指末尾那一堆）
F. n. 暖意（抽象：它带来的那份热气）
G. n. 那份热气（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The coal, meaning the fuel and not the mine
coal was the whole of the winter
the coal had become a number in a report
The coal of the whole thing
A coal, my grandmother said in 1971

answers.why: weigh coal 意为“称煤”，1946 年母亲被派去称她搬不动的那些煤。
coal 意为“煤、煤炭”，指那些燃料本身而不是那座矿井，共九英担，由最后来的人称。
coal 指地窖里每一堆煤，每一堆都是同样的煤灰。
coal 指末尾那一堆（煤商留下的那一堆），是唯一有人认真称过的。
coal 意为“暖意”，抽象指它带来的那份热气，父亲说 coal 就是那个冬天的全部。
coal 为抽象用法，指那份热气本身，是一个冬天里人人都分、却没人质疑的东西。
coal 意为“煤、煤炭”，到 1961 年这批 coal 成了报告里的一个数字。
coal 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九英担和十一年的过秤。
coal 意为“煤”，我记得的是末尾那一堆，1966 年称过，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
coal 为抽象总称，祖母说一堆煤是唯一会因为被认真过秤而变好的东西。

那些煤，指的是那些燃料本身而不是那座矿井，共九英担，由最后来的人称。（coal）

answers: In 1946 my mother was sent to weigh coal she could not lift, and she said the weighing was the whole of the lesson.
The coal, meaning the fuel and not the mine, was nine hundredweight and was weighed by whoever came last.
Every coal in that cellar had the same dust.
The coal at the end, meaning the one the merchant kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever weighed properly.
My father said coal was the whole of the winter, meaning the heat it carried and not the fuel.
